acceptedAnswer.text: The Kalabhairava Sahasranama is a sacred hymn consisting of 1000 names of Kalabhairava Baba, the Guru tatva of Lord Shiva. Chanting these 1000 names is a devotional practice to synchronize yourself with cosmic Guru.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of chanting Kalabhairava 1000 Names?

acceptedAnswer.text: Devotees believe that chanting or listening to the 1000 names annihilates fear, internal and external blocks, increases guru tatva within, and bring you closer to Ma Kali(Moksha).
Kalabhairava is the Guru of Shakti Vidya (the 5th Veda). He is the ever-present companion and GPS of the Shakta path, and the supreme guardian (firewall) of the sacred state of Kashi (Ma Kali).
